objective: Complete the first formerly-thin backend meta-type as an authored-source-to-three-language CLI vertical while preserving the CAV2-D65 chain.
claim_ceiling: DAG completion may support L0 candidate evidence only. It does not accept a successor baseline or authorize publication, release, deployment, production, or external effects.

selected_d65_chain.authored_source: Rule source body and L0 project fixtures
selected_d65_chain.compiled_graph: Typed Rule semantic IR plus deterministic compiled project graph and obligation projection
selected_d65_chain.exact_implementation_binding: Rule TypeScript, Python, and Rust candidate bindings
selected_d65_chain.conformance_evidence: Digest-bound positive, hostile, source-sensitivity, deterministic, native-equivalence, CLI, and independent-review results

execution_policy.failure_mode: collect-all within a node; downstream nodes become not_evaluable with causal blockers
execution_policy.mutation_rule: Use exact declared write scope and preserve unrelated dirty bytes.
execution_policy.binding_delegation_rule: Every new or materially revised exact implementation-binding candidate is authored and self-validated by exactly one bounded native helper through CA2-ROUTE-DELEGATE, then joined independently by the parent.
execution_policy.review_rule: Independent review is read-only and starts only after the implementation helper is closed and the exact postimage is frozen.

nodes.title: Freeze selected D65 predecessors and backend denominator
outputs: Exact selectors and digests for Rule, applicable relationships, adopted capability/ontology, 13 backend types, 17 backend relationships, 45 obligation IDs, toolchain, and @10
checks: Capability and ontology IDs match the adoption decision
nodes.done_when: One manifest uniquely resolves every selected predecessor and denominator.
stop_conditions: Missing or ambiguous selected definition
Capability or ontology identity mismatch
Any request to mutate @10

nodes.title: Capture exact drift and validation roots
read_scope: package manifests and validator entrypoints selected by L0-B00-01
outputs: Exact changed/missing baseline members, formalization binding state, test discovery roots, and tool versions
checks: No unrelated dirty file enters repair scope
Each disagreement has an owning validator and reproduction command
nodes.done_when: Every baseline failure is classified with an exact cause and bounded repair scope.
stop_conditions: Active writer overlaps selected repair bytes
Required toolchain cannot be resolved

nodes.title: Repair reproducibility without rewriting the predecessor
write_scope: Only successor implementation, validator, fixture, or package bytes explicitly classified by L0-B01-01
outputs: Bounded reproducibility repair and postimage inventory
checks: No hidden duplicate or cancelled test
nodes.done_when: Documented roots discover and run the same required checks without predecessor mutation.
stop_conditions: Repair requires authority-source mutation not selected by the current route

nodes.title: Run aggregate predecessor and package validation
read_scope: Current successor package and formalization surfaces
outputs: Causal results for baseline, formalization, CLI, clean-package, and native-language checks
checks: Every required check reports passed, failed, or not_evaluable
nodes.done_when: All required predecessor checks pass and the @10 digest is unchanged.
stop_conditions: Any required check fails or is not_evaluable

nodes.title: Extract the authored Rule semantic contract
read_scope: Exact Rule and relationship selectors from the requirement manifest
Current Rule schema, generator, and fixtures
outputs: Typed inputs, Boolean predicate grammar, reference rules, failure behavior, applicable DS-D8 obligations, and forbidden defaults
checks: Every semantic fact has an authored-source selector
nodes.done_when: The selected sources determine one executable Rule contract.
stop_conditions: Sources permit multiple incompatible behaviors
A required business algorithm is absent

nodes.title: Implement typed backend semantic IR
write_scope: projects/domainspec-v2/impl/cli/src input, compiler, and generation modules selected by the contract
outputs: Typed decode/validation and shared semantic IR consumed by validators and generators
checks: Malformed and incomplete semantics fail before generation
Generators do not independently interpret raw bodies
nodes.done_when: Rule authored bodies deterministically decode to one typed IR or a typed causal failure.
stop_conditions: IR requires an unselected definition change

nodes.title: Extract and preserve generic authoring invariants
read_scope: Existing Operation authoring flow and tests
outputs: Path, option, node construction, manifest refresh, and atomic publication invariants
nodes.done_when: The reusable authoring boundary is covered by failing-before-implementation contract tests.

nodes.title: Implement generic add dispatcher
outputs: Deterministic add dispatcher with type-specific decoders
checks: Invalid options produce no partial write
nodes.done_when: The dispatcher passes the generic contract and current Operation suite.

nodes.title: Implement Rule authoring and compiled-graph projection
read_scope: Typed Rule contract and semantic IR
write_scope: Rule authoring, compiler projection, obligation projection, fixtures, and focused tests
outputs: Applicable obligation IDs, predicates, and witnesses
checks: Compiled graph consumes exact project source
nodes.done_when: A Rule authored through the CLI appears with complete semantics and obligations in the compiled project graph.
stop_conditions: Projection must invent a missing semantic fact

nodes.title: Author and self-validate exact Rule binding candidates
read_scope: Frozen Rule contract, IR, graph projection, current three-language provider pattern
write_scope: Exact Rule TypeScript, Python, and Rust generator/provider files plus focused fixtures/tests
outputs: Three source-determined binding candidates and helper receipt
checks: Helper cannot accept its own binding
nodes.done_when: All three binding candidates are authored, self-validated, joined, and frozen as one exact postimage.
stop_conditions: More than one implementation helper without an approved fan-out sheet
Helper remains open or unjoined

nodes.title: Run Rule hostile and source-sensitivity corpus
read_scope: Frozen binding postimage and Rule corpus
outputs: Positive, invalid-shape, semantic-hostile, source-sensitivity, and obligation-mutant results
checks: Each mutant is killed by its named exact-cause test
Changing authored semantics changes graph and behavior
Unrelated source changes do not change Rule behavior
nodes.done_when: Every required case has a causal passed result.
stop_conditions: Any semantic mutant survives
Evidence is inferred from generated byte markers only

nodes.title: Run native cross-language equivalence
read_scope: Frozen binding postimage and shared Rule corpus
outputs: TypeScript, Python, and Rust executable result matrix
checks: Success, false, and error results agree
No fixture substitution or skipped native target
nodes.done_when: All three native targets agree on every selected corpus case.
stop_conditions: Required native toolchain is absent
Any target is skipped or disagrees

nodes.title: Replay the complete Rule vertical through the CLI
outputs: Receipts for add, compile, generate, formalize-currentness, and verify
nodes.done_when: One documented command sequence reproduces the complete Rule vertical from a clean temporary project.
stop_conditions: CLI depends on ambient workspace state
Partial output is reported as success

nodes.title: Perform independent read-only postimage review
read_scope: Exact frozen L0 candidate postimage and all L0 evidence
outputs: Independent findings, evidence gaps, claim ceiling, and disposition
checks: Reviewer did not author candidate bindings
Review covers D65 chain, source sensitivity, hostile cases, native parity, and protected hashes
nodes.done_when: Independent review returns no unresolved blocker-severity finding.
stop_conditions: Candidate bytes change during review
Reviewer is not independent

nodes.title: Join L0 evidence and decide promotion
read_scope: All L0 manifests, receipts, results, review, and exact postimage inventory
outputs: Collect-all node outcomes, protected digest result, remaining gaps, and continue/pivot/stop recommendation
nodes.done_when: All nodes pass and the receipt recommends L1, or causal blockers are recorded without promotion.
